narrative.intro: Sprezzatura Management Consulting obligated $240M in federal contracts in FY2026 to date. Sprezzatura Management Consulting won 6 awards so far this fiscal year, producing an average award size of $40M and driving obligations up 993.1% year over year. Fiscal history shows smaller annual obligations before FY2026: FY21 $15.8M, FY22 $15.6M, FY23 $19.4M, FY24 $13.5M, and FY25 $21.9M. Department of Veterans Affairs is the top buyer, obligating $240M to Sprezzatura Management Consulting this fiscal year. Custom Computer Programming Services is the dominant market with $234M in obligations, followed by Administrative Management and General Management Consulting Services at $5.6M and Computer Systems Design Services at $0. The current-year totals are partial and represent fiscal year to date activity. Award-value totals in the largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables are total contract values, while the other figures are contract obligations.
